notes: Zagreb-based early-stage VC with accelerator (up to €300K) and VC track; FRC3 fund €60M target (€45M first close, April 2025) with expansion to Romania. Website shows €104M AUM. Sector agnostic per aggregators (not recorded). No Slovak portfolio company found; FaceUp is Czech. Other 2026 deals (Hypefy, Genesis, Metastack) appear only on aggregators.
